acceptance: CI runs the live_singlestore tests on a schedule or on relevant PRs, with a green run linked.
TPC-DS maintenance on SingleStore SF0.01 either completes all 11 functions with row evidence, or stays skipped with the failing statements recorded.
context: 2026-11-07 owner decision (Joe, answering a choice dialog): "Add both jobs". Add a SingleStore job (amd64) to .github/workflows/docker-integration.yml that runs the live_singlestore tests.
description:
(1) #3979 added live SingleStore RF1 tests under the `live_singlestore` marker, but .github/workflows/docker-integration.yml has no SingleStore job, so they run only on a developer host. Under mocker the compose stack needs `mocker run --platform linux/amd64 -m 4g` because compose ignores the platform and the default 1 GiB VM aborts (uat-mocker-compose-gaps-20261106 context).
(2) The dsdgen maintenance change (#4015) reports TPC-DS maintenance on SingleStore as skipped, because the oracle review found its refresh SQL likely invalid there and it could not be validated.

Change. Add a SingleStore job to docker-integration (amd64 runner) that runs the live_singlestore marker. Validate the 11 TPC-DS maintenance functions on SingleStore and enable them, or record why they cannot run.

Guardrails: work in a linked worktree (make worktree-create); never edit the primary clone; heavy work only through make heavy-run; container checks under mocker one stack at a time (limits in tests/uat docs and the uat-mocker-compose-gaps-20261106 context); no live cloud without owner approval; no explanatory comments; changelog fragment if user-facing.
